artifactScope: Reviewer facts transcribed from retrieved source text, not raw publication bytes
title: Investigation of Historic Equilibrium Moisture Content Data from the Forest Products Laboratory
findings: The historic EMC dataset remains useful for practical drying and conditioning.
Incomplete methodology, interpolation provenance and uncertainty make it unsuitable as a definitive thermodynamic validation dataset.
A good empirical equation fit is not direct measurement of all species or of drying rates.
